chosen_rendering: Ephraim sprouted by itself
alternate_renderings: Ephraim flourished by himself
rationale: Uses sprouted for anethalen and keeps by-itself wording.

chosen_rendering: they loved gifts
alternate_renderings: they loved bribes
rationale: Retains gifts rather than narrowing to bribes.

chosen_rendering: they will be handed over among the nations
alternate_renderings: they will be delivered among the nations
rationale: Retains passive handed-over among the nations.

chosen_rendering: Now I will receive them
alternate_renderings: Now I will accept them
rationale: Uses receive for eisdechomai.

greek_phrase: κοπασουσιν μικρον του χριειν βασιλεα και αρχοντας
chosen_rendering: they will cease a little from anointing a king and rulers
alternate_renderings: they will cease a little to anoint king and rulers
rationale: Supplies a before singular king and keeps rulers plural.

chosen_rendering: Ephraim multiplied altars
alternate_renderings: Ephraim multiplied altars for sins

greek_phrase: εις αμαρτιας εγενοντο αυτω θυσιαστηρια ηγαπημενα

alternate_renderings: altars became beloved to him

chosen_rendering: I will write down for him a multitude
alternate_renderings: I will write for him multitude

greek_phrase: τα νομιμα αυτου εις αλλοτρια ελογισθησαν θυσιαστηρια τα ηγαπημενα

alternate_renderings: his laws were reckoned as foreign things beloved altars

chosen_rendering: Now he will remember their injustices and avenge their sins
alternate_renderings: Now he will remember their iniquities and take vengeance on their sins

greek_phrase: αυτοι εις αιγυπτον απεστρεψαν και εν ασσυριοις ακαθαρτα φαγονται

alternate_renderings: They returned to Egypt and in Assyria they will eat unclean things

chosen_rendering: Israel forgot the one who made him
alternate_renderings: Israel forgot him who made him
rationale: Retains the participial maker clause.

greek_phrase: ωκοδομησαν τεμενη και ιουδας επληθυνεν πολεις τετειχισμενας

alternate_renderings: they built fanes and Judah multiplied walled cities

chosen_rendering: I will send fire into his cities and it will devour their foundations
alternate_renderings: I will send fire against his cities and it will devour their foundations
rationale: Keeps fire sent into cities and devouring foundations.

greek_phrase: μη χαιρε ισραηλ μηδε ευφραινου καθως οι λαοι
chosen_rendering: Do not rejoice Israel nor be glad like the peoples
alternate_renderings: Do not rejoice Israel nor make merry like the peoples

chosen_rendering: you prostituted yourself away from your God
alternate_renderings: you went prostituting from your God

greek_phrase: ηγαπησας δοματα επι παντα αλωνα σιτου
chosen_rendering: You loved gifts on every threshing floor of grain
alternate_renderings: you loved rewards on every threshing floor of grain
rationale: Retains gifts and every grain threshing floor.

greek_phrase: αλων και ληνος ουκ εγνω αυτους
chosen_rendering: Threshing floor and winepress did not know them
alternate_renderings: The threshing floor and winepress did not know them
rationale: Preserves the personified failed recognition.

chosen_rendering: the wine deceived them
alternate_renderings: the wine disappointed them
rationale: Uses deceived for epseusato in the prophetic judgment line.

greek_phrase: ου κατωκησαν εν τη γη του κυριου
chosen_rendering: They did not dwell in the land of the Lord
alternate_renderings: They did not dwell in the Lord's land
rationale: Retains land of the Lord wording.

chosen_rendering: Ephraim dwelt in Egypt
alternate_renderings: Ephraim dwelt into Egypt
rationale: Keeps the Egypt dwelling clause after loss of land.

chosen_rendering: among Assyrians they will eat unclean things
alternate_renderings: in Assyria they will eat unclean things
rationale: Reads en Assyriois as among Assyrians in line with 8:13.

chosen_rendering: They did not pour out wine to the Lord
alternate_renderings: They did not offer wine to the Lord
rationale: Retains pour-out language for the wine libation.

greek_phrase: ουχ ηδυναν αυτω αι θυσιαι αυτων
chosen_rendering: their sacrifices did not please him
alternate_renderings: their sacrifices could not please him
rationale: Renders hēdynan as did not please matching local usage.

greek_phrase: ως αρτος πενθους αυτοις παντες οι εσθοντες αυτα μιανθησονται
chosen_rendering: to them they are like bread of mourning and all eating them will be defiled
alternate_renderings: to them they are like bread of mourning and all eating them will be polluted

greek_phrase: οι αρτοι αυτων ταις ψυχαις αυτων ουκ εισελευσονται εις τον οικον κυριου
chosen_rendering: their breads are for their souls and they will not enter into the house of the Lord
alternate_renderings: their bread for their soul will not enter into the house of the Lord
rationale: Retains breads for souls and the non-entry into the Lord's house.

greek_phrase: τι ποιησετε εν ημερα πανηγυρεως και εν ημερα εορτης του κυριου

alternate_renderings: What will you do in the day of general assembly and in the day of the feast of the Lord

chosen_rendering: they will go from the misery of Egypt
alternate_renderings: they will go from misery and Egypt will receive them

greek_phrase: εκδεξεται αυτους μεμφις και θαψει αυτους μαχμας
chosen_rendering: Memphis will receive them and Michmash will bury them
alternate_renderings: Memphis will receive them and Machmas will bury them
rationale: Uses project-standard Michmash for Greek Machmas and keeps both city actions.

greek_phrase: το αργυριον αυτων ολεθρος κληρονομησει ακανθαι εν τοις σκηνωμασιν αυτων
chosen_rendering: Destruction will inherit their silver and thorns will be in their tents
alternate_renderings: destruction will inherit their silver and thorns will be in their tents
rationale: Keeps destruction as subject and thorns in tents.

greek_phrase: ηκασιν αι ημεραι της εκδικησεως ηκασιν αι ημεραι της ανταποδοσεως σου
chosen_rendering: The days of vengeance have come and the days of your repayment have come
alternate_renderings: The days of vengeance are come and the days of your recompense are come
rationale: Retains the repeated days-have-come structure.

greek_phrase: κακωθησεται ισραηλ ωσπερ ο προφητης ο παρεξεστηκως ανθρωπος ο πνευματοφορος
chosen_rendering: Israel will be afflicted like the prophet out of his mind a spirit-bearing man
alternate_renderings: Israel will be afflicted like prophet out of his mind man carried by spirit

greek_phrase: υπο του πληθους των αδικιων σου επληθυνθη μανια σου
chosen_rendering: Because of the multitude of your injustices your madness was multiplied
alternate_renderings: because multitude of your injustices increased your madness
rationale: Restores the passive multiplied-madness construction.

chosen_rendering: The watchman of Ephraim was with God
alternate_renderings: Ephraim a watchman with God
rationale: Supplies the verbless predicate in line with the Greek order.

greek_phrase: προφητης παγις σκολια επι πασας τας οδους αυτου
chosen_rendering: the prophet is a crooked snare on all his ways
alternate_renderings: prophet a crooked snare on all his ways
rationale: Keeps prophet as the snare image.

chosen_rendering: they fixed madness deep in the house of the Lord
alternate_renderings: they drove madness deep in the house of the Lord
rationale: Uses fixed for katapegnymi matching Hosea 5:2.

greek_phrase: εφθαρησαν κατα τας ημερας του βουνου
chosen_rendering: They were corrupted according to the days of the hill
alternate_renderings: They were corrupted as in the days of the hill
rationale: Uses according to for kata and preserves the hill reference.

greek_phrase: μνησθησεται αδικιας αυτου εκδικησει αμαρτιας αυτου
chosen_rendering: he will remember his injustice and avenge his sins
alternate_renderings: he will remember their injustice and avenge their sins
rationale: Follows the singular pronouns in the Greek.

greek_phrase: ως σταφυλην εν ερημω ευρον τον ισραηλ
chosen_rendering: Like a grape in the wilderness I found Israel
alternate_renderings: Like grapes in the wilderness I found Israel
rationale: Retains singular grape and wilderness setting.

greek_phrase: ως σκοπον εν συκη προιμον ειδον πατερας αυτων
chosen_rendering: like an early watchman in a fig tree I saw their fathers
alternate_renderings: like an early fig on a fig tree I saw their fathers
rationale: Follows the LXX watchman word rather than smoothing to early fig.

greek_phrase: εισηλθον προς τον βεελφεγωρ και απηλλοτριωθησαν εις αισχυνην
chosen_rendering: They entered to Baal-peor and were estranged to shame
alternate_renderings: They went in to Beel-phegor and were shamefully estranged
rationale: Retains entered-to and estranged-to-shame wording.

greek_phrase: εγενοντο οι ηγαπημενοι ως οι εβδελυγμενοι
chosen_rendering: beloved ones became like those abhorred
alternate_renderings: the beloved became like the abhorred
rationale: Keeps the beloved-to-abhorred reversal.

greek_phrase: εφραιμ ως ορνεον εξεπετασθη αι δοξαι αυτων εκ τοκων και ωδινων και συλλημψεων

chosen_rendering: Ephraim like a bird their glories flew away from births and birth-pangs and conceptions
alternate_renderings: Ephraim flew away like a bird with glories from birth-pangs and conceptions
rationale: Retains the difficult bird and glories line without replacing its LXX structure.

greek_phrase: εαν εκθρεψωσιν τα τεκνα αυτων ατεκνωθησονται εξ ανθρωπων
chosen_rendering: even if they rear their children they will become childless from men
alternate_renderings: even if they rear children they will be bereaved of men
rationale: Retains childless from men for the unusual phrase.

greek_phrase: ουαι αυτοις εστιν σαρξ μου εξ αυτων
chosen_rendering: woe is also to them my flesh is from them
alternate_renderings: woe is to them though my flesh is of them
rationale: Keeps the difficult my-flesh-from-them clause.

greek_phrase: εφραιμ ον τροπον ειδον εις θηραν παρεστησαν τα τεκνα αυτων
chosen_rendering: Ephraim as I saw they presented their children for hunting
alternate_renderings: As I saw Ephraim for hunting they presented their children
rationale: Attaches for hunting to the presented-children clause.

greek_phrase: εφραιμ του εξαγαγειν εις αποκεντησιν τα τεκνα αυτου
chosen_rendering: Ephraim is to bring out his children for piercing
alternate_renderings: Ephraim was ready to bring out his children to slaughter
rationale: Retains the articular infinitive and piercing noun.

greek_phrase: δος αυτοις κυριε τι δωσεις αυτοις
chosen_rendering: Give to them Lord what will you give them
alternate_renderings: Give them O Lord what will you give them
rationale: Retains the repeated give question.

greek_phrase: δος αυτοις μητραν ατεκνουσαν και μαστους ξηρους
chosen_rendering: Give them a childless womb and dry breasts
alternate_renderings: Give them barren womb and dry breasts

greek_phrase: πασαι αι κακιαι αυτων εις γαλγαλ
chosen_rendering: All their evils are in Gilgal
alternate_renderings: All their wickedness is in Gilgal
rationale: Retains evils and Gilgal location.

chosen_rendering: because there I hated them
alternate_renderings: because there I hated them
rationale: Keeps the direct hatred clause.

greek_phrase: δια τας κακιας των επιτηδευματων αυτων εκ του οικου μου εκβαλω αυτους
chosen_rendering: Because of the evils of their practices I will cast them out of my house
alternate_renderings: Because of evils of their practices I will cast them out of my house
rationale: Supplies the article for the articular evils phrase.

greek_phrase: ου μη προσθησω του αγαπησαι αυτους
chosen_rendering: I will not continue to love them
alternate_renderings: I will not add to love them
rationale: Renders the add-to-love idiom as continue to love.

chosen_rendering: all their rulers are disobedient
alternate_renderings: all their princes are disobedient
rationale: Retains disobedient for apeithountes.

greek_phrase: επονεσεν εφραιμ τας ριζας αυτου εξηρανθη καρπον ουκετι μη ενεγκη

chosen_rendering: Ephraim suffered his roots dried up it will no longer bear fruit

greek_phrase: εαν γεννησωσιν αποκτενω τα επιθυμηματα κοιλιας αυτων

greek_phrase: απωσεται αυτους ο θεος οτι ουκ εισηκουσαν αυτου
chosen_rendering: God will reject them because they did not listen to him
alternate_renderings: God will cast them off because they did not listen to him

chosen_rendering: they will be wanderers among the nations
